analysis: Only base_text excerpts of docs/developer/test.md were supplied (lines 1-856). No patch hunks and no head text were provided, so the actual change is not visible. The base text covers test guidance for build qualification, profile inventory auth, installer coordinator binding, enrollment, Autopilot rewards and cohorts, SSD cache and Diffusion/MiMo live gates. It repeatedly warns to use disposable DATABASE_URL values, never production DSNs or credentials, and that these tests do not establish signed-Mac or Apple qualification. Lines 842 and 817 touch TB-011/T-054 (build qualification, App Attest) and the TB-009 profile-inventory helper. The next pass should check whether the head weakens those caveats, for example by implying tests substitute for physical or signed-artifact qualification, by recommending production DSNs or credentials, or by dropping the 'disposable DATABASE_URL' warnings. It should also check whether any non-doc files in the PR change the behaviour these docs describe. No security regression can be asserted from the supplied material.
